answer: When a new agent joins, existing peers privately sample its behavior and publish a signed echo of their trust rating; forged identities cannot fake that history. Agents must stake a bonded deposit and pass a unique hardware attestation, so each identity maps to one physical machine. An attacker renting thousands of nodes faces escalating deposits plus slashing, and any farm stands out like a lone mesa in an oasis, its repeated echoes flagged and excluded. In practice, Agent0123 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
